remarks: Sun filled 1BR/1BA condo in the desirable Springdale neighborhood featuring hardwood floors throughout, ample closet space, and a large bedroom that easily fits a king-size bed and updated bath. The bright and airy kitchen includes an opening to the spacious living/dining area, and the unit boasts new lighting, hardware, window treatments and was freshly painted throughout 2025! Rent includes heat, hot water, cooking gas, and a reserved parking space close to the main entrance. Convenient laundry available on each floor! Hyde Park has a secured entry, beautiful lobby and fitness center. Enjoy walking distance to restaurants, shops, coffee spots, the train, and public transportation. A perfect blend of comfort and convenience! Just move right in!

facts.laundryLoc: Each floor has their own laundry room
